Examples.Title: lookup
Examples.Description:
lookup the document(s) associated with a processId, bucketId, groupId, or projectId.

Interact with the "Request Body" below to explore the arguments of this function. Enter your GroundX API key to send a request directly from this web page. Select your language of choice to structure a code snippet based on your specified arguments.
Examples.Code:
### lookup
# @name Document_lookup
GET {{host}}/v1/ingest/documents/{{id}}?n={{n}}&filter={{filter}}&sort=name&sortOrder=asc&status=queued&nextToken={{nextToken}}
X-API-Key: {{api_key}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Look up success
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Invalid process, bucket, group, or project ID
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized to access process, bucket, group, or project with given ID
